crossRefs.note: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.

translations.web: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.
translations.bsb: And the priest is to examine the mildew and isolate the contaminated fabric for seven days.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:
translations.asv: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up that which hath the plague seven days:
